added_comments.text:
# Non-ISO shapes some partners still send. Anything ISO 8601 (with or without
# 'T', 'Z', a numeric offset, or fractional seconds of any precision) is
# handled by datetime.fromisoformat before we fall back to these.
# Naive timestamps are UTC by convention; aware ones are converted.
# Numeric UTC offsets (Acme), with fractional seconds of any precision.

rationale: The agent removed the mangling in _clean() and the HACK format list, replacing them with generic ISO 8601 parsing via datetime.fromisoformat plus a small legacy fallback, so the whole class of offset/fractional-second inputs works rather than just the reported one. The Globex end-of-day branch and its helper are untouched, and tests cover multiple precisions and offsets.
